points.description: States that insertion and deletion can be performed in constant time (O(1), fixed time, independent of list length). Accept answers that add that this includes operations before a given location/node or at the end/tail of the list.
points.partial_credit: Use the levels for partly correct answers.

levels.says: Says only deletion or only insertion is constant time, not both.
Says a doubly-linked list makes insertion or deletion easier or faster (e.g., can delete without searching for the previous node) but does not state constant time.
Mentions only that operations before a given location or at the end are possible or easier, without saying insertion/deletion is constant time.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that insertion and deletion are constant time/O(1), i.e. fixed time independent of list length; adding that this covers before a given node or at the tail is acceptable but not required. Part marks for only one of insertion/deletion, for saying faster/easier without constant time, or for only mentioning before/end operations. No marks for unrelated advantages such as bidirectional traversal alone.
